notes: Returned Tanks se shift kiya gaya tank ab destination plan/item/phase par khud screen par nazar ata hai, apni asal quantity ke saath — pehle screen sab se purane tank par ruk jati thi aur quantity nazar nahi ati thi. Shift aur transfer ke tamam picker ab ek hi popup chain mein hain: pehle Plan, phir Phase, phir Item; har popup kam az kam 5 rows uncha hota hai, zyada options hon to andar scroll hota hai. Mega tank ab baghair phase ke hain aur un ka naam khud rakh sakte hain — banate waqt naam poocha jata hai. Koi bhi Mega tank delete ho sakta hai, us mein maujood stock exact wapas credit ho jata hai; purane seeded TOP/FOAM tank bhi aam tank hain. Mega screen par ab Plan/Item selectors nazar nahi ate, sirf Department rehta hai. Returned Tanks mein tank beech mein nazar ate hain, aur kisi tank ko tap karne par us ki composition popup mein khulti hai.
releaseNotes: FG shift-fix + Mega redesign pack: F1 destination focus after a shift (the shifted tank itself renders with its exact kg; carousel no longer resets to the oldest tank); F2 one shared FgPickerPopup chain (Plan > Phase > Item, Mega quantity step) with a 5-option-row minimum height, growth to ~full screen and internal scroll, applied to Returned shift, Mega shift and all tank transfers; F3 Mega tanks phaseless + free-named (createMegaTank), deleteMegaTank credits held stock back exactly (seeded tanks ordinary, megaSeeded marker prevents resurrection), Mega mode renders no Plan/Item selectors, Mega prep offers the union of tank-phase materials; F4 Returned Tanks centered tank visuals + composition as a popup. Authorized live repair, read-back verified: A-2 restored to 11.74 kg trip remainder (composition/deducted rebuilt, leftover=false), F-3 DOP corrected by exactly -2.00 kg to its 20.00 kg trip remainder across composition/deducted/provenance; all other 26 tanks byte-identical, no stock buckets touched.
